files.description: This Python file implements a live JSON backup writer for the codedoc pipeline, providing a crash-safety mechanism that ensures data integrity during processing. It manages a dedicated recovery file that is updated throughout the run and deleted upon successful completion. The class SafeWriter handles the writing of results in a thread-safe manner, ensuring atomic writes to prevent corruption.
files.role_in_system: The SafeWriter class is integral to the codedoc pipeline, allowing for safe and reliable output of processed files. It interacts with other components of the codedoc system by managing the recovery of data in case of interruptions, thus supporting the overall stability and reliability of the pipeline.

functions.name: set_queue_order
functions.description: Sets the topological processing order for the files array. It must be called before initialize_empty() and any record() calls. It is thread-safe.

functions.name: load
functions.description: Pre-populates in-memory state from an existing recovery file or output. It accepts an optional preloaded dictionary and raises a ConfigError if the recovery path is not valid.

functions.name: size
functions.description: Property that returns the number of results currently recorded in memory.

functions.name: _flush_locked
functions.description: Serializes the current state to disk atomically. It must be called while holding the lock and handles the physical write to ensure no corruption occurs during a crash.

classes.name: SafeWriter
classes.description: Responsible for managing the live-output writing process, persisting completed file results immediately. It includes attributes for the recovery file path, output format, and records of processed files, and ensures thread safety and atomic writes.
